description.text: This program is designed to turn out Chinese language talents with basic Chinese literature knowledge and language technics and are capable of appreciating Chinese literature as well as have strong ability of speaking and writing. Major Course: Ancient Chinese, Modern Chinese, Introduction to Linguistics, Contemporary Literature History of China, Contemporary Chinese Literature, History of classical Chinese Literature, World Literature, Introduction to Literature, Fundamental Course of Composition

duration.text: The Chinese Language and Culture at University of Electronic Science and Technology of China is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above
